svg.title: uTest Machinery — from C code and SDDs to executable test evidence
svg.desc: A four-step workflow: select C and SDD inputs, generate traceable test benches, verify offline, and understand results. Highlights traceability, source immutability, evidence and honesty about undetermined behavior.
svg.text: From C code and SDDs to executable test evidence
Traceable, reproducible host-side verification for embedded software
Original C and SDD stay read-only
From C code and specifications to reproducible, reviewable test evidence.
